eng.summary: Leap Drop-In Gymnastics: Ages 3–5 — Introductory Trial Class
eng.content:
A coached recreational gymnastics class for younger children. Participants develop foundational gymnastics skills, confidence, coordination, balance, strength, and body awareness through work on age-appropriate gymnastics equipment.

Important note:This is the same introductory trial class offered on every date. Each session covers the same introductory skills and does not progress from week to week. It is designed for new families to experience Leap before registering for a regular program. Families seeking ongoing skill development should register for a regular weekly class.

Progressive Weekly Gymnastics

This class is part of Leap’s structured School Year recreational program and is designed for consistent instruction and skill progression. Children are welcome to join during the school year where space is available and begin from their current level. Once registered, your child keeps this weekly class spot while enrolled and continues progressing with their group.

Flexible Enrolment

Tuition is $95/month while enrolled. Families may withdraw at any time subject to Leap’s withdrawal policy, including the required 15 days’ written notice.

Leap Elite Foundations is Leap’s developmental/pre-competitive program for selected athletes.

The program bridges recreational gymnastics and the competitive stream. Athletes train four hours each week, focusing on foundational gymnastics skills, strength, flexibility, technique, coordination and body control in preparation for future competitive levels.

Registration is available only to athletes selected following a competitive assessment.
